headline: Bank of Israel Keeps Benchmark Rate Unchanged at 3.25%
summary: The Bank of Israel left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.25%, balancing annual inflation that slowed to 1.1% against high domestic and global geopolitical uncertainty.
why: The Bank of Israel sets key borrowing rates to maintain price stability, economic growth, and financial system resilience in Israel.

impacts.name: Israeli Shekel
impacts.why: The central bank held borrowing costs steady at 3.25% due to persistent geopolitical risks.
